contract.status: prospective toy calibration and gated saved-native application
contract.scientific_question: Can a predeclared prediction-selected polynomial background avoid constant-background bias while rejecting widths that remain ambiguous on the available energy window?

estimator.selection: Lowest admissible order in each window; all admissible orders/starts/folds enter parameter envelopes. Audit data reject but never select. Any unsuccessful or bound fit leaves the case verdict unset.

calibration.requirements: All 30 cases retained. Required resolved linear controls pass at every grid; designated negatives never accepted. Every accepted isolated-pole case meets known-pole truth budgets. Unitarity is checked independently. Neighboring-pole case is outside the isolated-pole premise and cannot qualify that premise.

native_application.requirements: Calibration must pass first. Checksum-verified original native stages/resources, complete exports, maps/grids/Pi and nonempty/noMAXFIT native fits must qualify. No refitting rule changes after audit data. Keep all historical rejected extraction gates. Native output reconstruction is not independent scattering or S-matrix pole certification.

contract.stopping_rule: False/unset calibration stops before native application. Keep every case, failed fit and original exit; no changed budgets, case removal or automatic successor.
